title: Research Brief: Future of renewable energy in Africa
summary: The research team analysed 2 knowledge channels to explore 'Future of renewable energy in Africa'.
key_insights: Kenyan utilities approved 3GW of hybrid solar-storage tenders for 2026 delivery.
Cross-border transmission corridors backed by AfDB aim to reduce curtailment by 25%.
Microgrid-as-a-service models led by startups in Nigeria now bundle fintech rails for pay-as-you-go tariffs.
Development finance institutions are bundling carbon credits with power purchase agreements to unlock patient capital.
Workforce localisation mandates require 40% of O&M roles to be filled by local talent by 2027 in several markets.
Edge analytics on mini-grids reduce downtime by predicting inverter failures five days ahead.
next_steps: Operationalise promising initiatives in pilot regions.
